shortDescription: Configures a SQL database user in a Microsoft SQL Server instance.

options.name: database
options.description: The name of the database for which to configure the SQL Login as a user.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The hostname of the SQL Server instance to configure.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the SQL Server instance.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port on which the SQL Server instance is listening.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the SQL Server instance.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the SQL Login to configure as a database user.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the SQL Login.
